description: This file defines the MacPort class, a subclass of base.Port, implementing platform-specific functionality for Chromium's testing infrastructure on macOS, including version handling, fallback paths, build checks, and system paths.

classes.name: MacPort
classes.description: A class representing the macOS-specific port of the Chromium testing infrastructure, handling versioning, fallback paths, build instructions, and system paths.

methods.name: determine_full_port_name
methods.description: Determines the full port name based on host platform OS version and high DPI status.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the MacPort instance, extracting the version from the port name.

methods.name: check_build
methods.description: Checks the build environment and logs instructions if the build check fails.

methods.name: operating_system
methods.description: Returns the string 'mac' indicating the operating system.

methods.name: path_to_apache
methods.description: Returns the system path to the Apache HTTP server.

methods.name: path_to_apache_config_file
methods.description: Returns the path to the Apache configuration file.

methods.name: _path_to_driver
methods.description: Returns the path to the driver application, optionally for a specific target.
